critical_code_review_comments: BrandSpecs.jsx cleanly centralises per-brand height override (h prop) and mobile-vs-desktop layout via sm: breakpoint only - correct approach; no changes recommended.
Static PNG assets (kcp/kone/vasavi) served from /public/assets/brands as expected; sizes are reasonable (18KB-190KB) and use RGBA transparency - no white-box wrappers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M672 logo swap verified: /public/assets/brands/kcp.png (589x592), kone.png (1600x619), vasavi.png (930x259) are the authoritative brand assets. BrandSpecs.jsx uses per-brand h override (KCP h-11 md:h-14, KONE/Vasavi h-10 md:h-12) with w-auto object-contain, so aspect ratios are preserved exactly (verified rend_ar vs nat_ar diff < 0.0005). Projects list still has 19 items; Skylark and Summit are the two KONE lift projects; all others use Vasavi.
